By browsing and purchasing on RycreoShop, you agree to our fair terms of service:

1. Order Verification:
Cash on Delivery orders are subject to telephone or WhatsApp confirmation before parcel dispatch from our hub.

2. Pricing & Currency:
All product prices are quoted in Bangladeshi Taka (৳ BDT). Prices include high-grade tamper-proof safety packaging.

3. Doorstep Parcel Inspection:
Customers are welcome to inspect parcels at the doorstep in front of the delivery agent before completing payment.

4. 7-Day Exchange Policy:
Unused, unwashed items with tags and original packaging intact qualify for a hassle-free exchange within 7 days.

Outside Dhaka (Suburbs & All Districts):

Every parcel is sealed in tamper-proof security packaging. You are entitled to verify the parcel upon arrival.
